In my opinion technology have change the way we learn english. When I was child, we only had textbook and teacher but now students can watching videos and use apps everyday

There are three advantage of online learning:
- it is cheap and flexible
- you can study at you're own pace
- you can practise with people from other countrys

However it is also some disadvantage. For example many student feel lonely and they dont have motivation to study alone. Furthermore, the colour of the screen is bad for eyes, and it make people tired. On the other hand, I think that the advantages outweigh the disadvantages, as long as students organise their time carefully.
